description: Returns the list of AWS account credits for the specified account. Each credit includes its identifier, type, monetary amounts, applicable products, expiration, sharing configuration, and current enabled status.

researchLinks.description: Beyond valid credentials: How exposed AWS keys are tested for Amazon Bedrock access

securityImplications: Attackers might use GetCredits to check how much promotional credit a compromised account has, picking accounts where LLMjacking or other resource hijacking is absorbed by credits and noticed later.
